Overview: Constella Deepcut Systems (CDS) is a national defense integrator building an on-prem LLM–powered analyst assistant for classified document synthesis. They require an air-gapped Private deployment (data diode + controlled export), HSM-backed keys, and RMF/ATO-grade artifacts.

Recent timeline:
- 2025-11-12: Intro call (Ethan) — high-level scope, CDS prefers self-hosted, mentioned FIPS/HSM requirements.
- 2025-12-05: Security intake form submitted (SE: Marina). Initial gaps: need STIG mapping, HSM vendor list.
- 2026-01-14: Architecture workshop (Marina, infra team) — discussed data diode, offline model updates via secure media, offline telemetry model. Action: produce PoC architecture diagram.
- 2026-02-18: POC kickoff call (fireflies:call_2026-02-18-constella-poc). Agreed on air-gapped PoC: 2-node GPU cluster (non-internet), offline model bundle transfer process, isolated control plane in VPC with customer-managed KMS/HSM.
- 2026-03-02: Security deep-dive w/ CDS ISSO (fireflies:call_2026-03-02-security-deepdive). ISSO requires: FIPS 140-2 HSM, STIG checklists, RMF package template, audit log retention policy (7 years), and physical access attestations.
- 2026-03-08: Commercial terms high-level agreed; procurement wants SOW + hardware spec + proof of HSM compatibility.

Technical notes / requirements snippets:
- Workloads: analyst assistant (chat-style with strict context truncation), embeddings for secure search across classified corpora, on-demand summarization of long reports. Low-latency not <20ms/token; acceptable tail latency up to 150ms for batch tasks. Throughput: moderate (peaks ~120 concurrent user sessions across classified networks).
- Model profile: prefer trimmed open models that can be quantized; ability to pin model versions and ship offline model bundles. Need offline verification of model checksums and signed artifact handling.
- Ops/Controls: no telemetry leaving air-gapped environment. Remote ops via jump host approved only with signed change tickets. Strong need for removable-media transfer workflow (sneakernet) documented.

Procurement / legal signals:
- Budget: central purchasing has placeholder $750k ARR commit if ATO step is satisfied.
- Procurement timeline: expects SOW + pricing in Q2 2026; formal procurement review week of 2026-05-04.
